maxPercent.note: No maximum rate published. Searched: the product page, the blogs, credit fee schedule Phụ lục 1.3 (04/2026), base-rate notice (effective 05/02/2026), average-lending-rate PDFs, Techcombank Mobile listings on Google Play and the App Store, the loan calculator (rate is user-typed). basis.note: Source wording: "trên dư nợ giảm dần".

amortization.note: The product page says reducing balance but not the instalment type. Equal instalments are our classification: the blog's worked example shows equal instalments of 1,785,407, and the general credit terms (clause 4.4) describe equal-instalment 'niên kim' repayment when the contract agrees it.

timing.note: Charged only when the borrower prepays. The general credit terms (clause 4.5) say early repayment needs the bank's written consent and a fee set in the contract. No fee under 100,000 VND remaining principal (clause 4.4 b iv).

mandatory.note: Only applies if the borrower chooses to prepay; not a condition of getting the loan.

minVnd.note: Sources disagree on the minimum (200,000 vs 800,000 / 400,000 / 200,000), see conflicts[]. Left unknown.

researchNotes: LICENSING: Techcombank is on data/licensed-institutions.json (id techcombank, bank). OFFICIAL PAGES FOUND (2026-11-02): the unsecured instalment loan (https://techcombank.com/khach-hang-ca-nhan/vay/vay-tieu-dung/vay-tieu-dung-tin-chap), MyCash (https://techcombank.com/khach-hang-ca-nhan/vay/vay-tieu-dung/mycash) and the unsecured overdraft credit line (https://techcombank.com/khach-hang-ca-nhan/vay/vay-tieu-dung/vay-han-muc-thau-chi-khong-tai-san-dam-bao). All three were previously known only through blogs. The 'đã hết hạn' (expired) text seen by earlier readers is a hidden template span (class 'article-expired-text hidden') on every Techcombank page, not a real expiry; the HTTP last-modified of the three product pages is 2026-07-20. WHAT IS PUBLISHED: instalment loan: from 12.9%/year reducing balance, up to 1 billion VND, 12-60 months, age 20-70, income 10 million. MyCash: from 380 VND per million per day, fee schedule and overdue rates in a PDF, blank contract form. Overdraft line: from 1.2%/month, 3-12 months, age 20-60, income 5 million, 'miễn phí mọi loại phí'. WHAT IS NOT PUBLISHED (searched, not found): any maximum rate or rate table for any of the three; unsecured-loan contract or fee line for application/disbursement; insurance terms; late-penalty rate for the instalment loan and the overdraft line. Searched: the three product pages, techcombank.com/cong-cu-tien-ich/bieu-phi-bieu-mau-dich-vu (all KHCN biểu phí, biểu mẫu and ĐKĐK PDFs; the only loan documents are 'Biểu phí Dịch vụ tín dụng' listed 13/04/2026, the loan-application terms of 12/05/2022 (about credit approval-in-principle, no rates), and general credit terms of 02/05/2018), the Lãi suất page (empty rate sections), the loan calculator (user types the rate), the base-rate notice effective 05/02/2026 (benchmark only; not tied to these products), the Google Play and App Store listings of Techcombank Mobile (no loan text), and blogs. Average-lending-rate PDFs exist (monthly, whole individual book) and are benchmarks, not product rates; not recorded. CONTRADICTIONS (in conflicts[]): amount 1 billion vs 100 million vs 400 million; term 12-60 vs 20-36; rate 12.9%/year vs the blogs' 1.2%/month (which is the official wording for the overdraft line); MyCash 380 vs 408 VND/million/day vs the old 16-25%/year; early-repayment minimum 200,000 vs 800,000/400,000/200,000. SURPRISING: (1) the 'expired' labels are a template artifact; (2) the blog's 1.2%/month looks like the overdraft line's rate attached to the instalment loan; (3) the credit fee schedule has an early-repayment row for a 'vay tiền' product with flat interest (0.25% x prepaid principal x months early), which suggests Techcombank also lends on flat interest somewhere, but no product page says so; (4) the instalment loan's only worked example (blog) has arithmetic errors. All three products stay out of the ranking: each has only a 'từ' floor.
